No findings in the intent/requirements review of treams-rs c4d9613..da35ce0 and Advect 0e7a74b..e3f7f03.

  • Both remove the obsolete extension feature and redundant Maturin selection. No other workspace features remain, so dropping --all-features does not omit an existing feature configuration.
  • Both remove the blanket Clippy warning level while retaining pedantic, nursery, individual restrictions, and CI’s -D warnings.
  • The simplified sdist jobs preserve archive checks, rebuilt-wheel checks, isolated installation smoke tests, and source-only artifact uploads.
  • treams Hypothesis configuration explicitly enables health checks without discarding CI defaults. Its suite-rule assertion checks the active profile. Advect’s existing configuration already derives both profiles from the built-in default; no redundant fix is needed.

These changes alone do not justify a separate release: they improve development and verification configuration without establishing a user-facing defect in published artifacts.
